changelog: Security (cross-world isolation, content + audit): every organization now sees only its own activity log, support queue and content pools. `ActivityLog.orgId` and `ProjectTaskTemplate.orgId` are new nullable columns (both registered in `TENANT_MODELS`); `logActivity()` stamps the org (explicit, else the actor's, else the target user's — `src/lib/activityOrgRule.ts`), and two idempotent deploy backfills (`prisma/backfill-activity-log-org.mjs`, `prisma/backfill-task-template-org.mjs`) attribute legacy rows before `backfill-organization.mjs` gives the rest to the default org. `/api/admin/activity`, `/api/admin/support` (GET/POST/PUT, a foreign ticket is 404), the support admin fan-out, the message-template, goal-template and to-do-template pools, `PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/announcements/[id]` and the announcement/newsletter image routes are narrowed to the caller's tenant by hand (#2542 pattern). Built-in document templates and curated newsletters are keyed by vertical: a MARKETING tenant is offered none of the internship career content, and the goal starter pool is seeded into the default org only.

en: Each organization now sees only its own activity log, support tickets and templates.
tr: Her kurum artık yalnızca kendi etkinlik günlüğünü, destek taleplerini ve şablonlarını görüyor.
de: Jede Organisation sieht jetzt nur noch ihr eigenes Aktivitätsprotokoll, ihre Support-Tickets und Vorlagen.
